pages.title: The Road
pages.text: You were a traveler, Traveling from a distant land, you picked up your life an set off.$(br2)A life of adventure before you.$(br2)You contracted a mysterious plague, forced to take refuge in nearby village.$(br2)You felt the life sapping from you, your strength fading.

pages.title: The Seventh Night
pages.text: It was that 7th night when a mysterious woman arrived in town.$(br2)Her hairs as white as snow.$(br2)Her eyes, like azure and ruby gemstones.$(br2)She tended to your dying body, caring for your sickness.$(br2)She spoke no words.$(br2)Made no sounds.$(br2)She left the following morning.

pages.title: The Morning After
pages.text: Your mind races with confusion.$(br2)Who was that?$(br2)The world awaits you.$(br2)And life seems almost brighter.$(br2)You set off.$(br2)Adventure awaits.$(br2)Yours.
